description: Locked snapshot descriptors for REAP paper datasets. A dataset entry is committed here once its snapshot has been materialized and its SHA256 frozen. Loaders under src/reap/datasets/ read from `~/.cache/reap/datasets/<name>/<version>/` — this file is the authoritative record of what that cache *should* contain.

ai_art.license_note: Publicly-available corpus; treated as public-domain for research use. Sibling pipeline code (When-Algorithms-Meet-Artists) is GPL-3.0.
ai_art.labels_note: No per-chunk expert labels exist. Cluster-level human-verified topic labels live upstream but are not per-sample ground truth, so the snapshot exposes `labels=None`.
ai_art.citation_status: Citation pending — real BibTeX must be added at publication time, attributing the When-Algorithms-Meet-Artists corpus authors. Do not fabricate a placeholder.

korean_forest.license_note: Publicly-available corpus (Republic of Korea forest-policy documents across Moon/Park/Lee administrations); treated as public-domain for research use.

labels.source_description: Human-authored policy-strategy descriptor attached by the corpus authors; the string-to-integer map is recorded in the snapshot's metadata.notes.

korean_forest.chunking: one row per strategy sentence (pre-chunked by Hye In)
korean_forest.citation_status: Citation pending — real BibTeX must be added at publication time, attributing Hye In Kim's Korean forest-policy corpus. Do not fabricate a placeholder.

korean_forest_oos.license_note: Publicly-available presidential pledge corpus; treated as public-domain for research use.

labels.source_description: Cluster assignment from REAP's projection head + nearest-centroid against the 18-d consensus space defined by the reference Korean forest planning corpus. Source xlsx files use 1-indexed values; loader normalizes to 0-indexed.

subgroups.description: Presidential election cycle the pledge sentence belongs to. Used by reap.filter.calibrate_per_subgroup.

korean_forest_oos.chunking: one row per district-level pledge sentence (provenance: green-narrative/hye_in source corpus)
data_quality_flags: Park source xlsx has its text column renamed to the Korean letter 'ㅎ' (a typo); the loader maps it back to text_sentence on import.
Park and Moon files contain duplicated rows in some (cluster, president) cells; affects centroid estimates marginally (reported in §4.7.3).
Moon file has OCR artifacts (random Latin character fragments) consistent with PDF-based extraction.
korean_forest_oos.citation_status: Citation pending — real BibTeX must be added at publication time, attributing the South Korean presidential pledge corpus authors. Do not fabricate a placeholder.
korean_forest_oos.manuscript_role: Powers the §4.7 OOS conformal filter validation and the §16 pre-registered Korean-forest filter replication. Reference reproduced metrics: 846/1662 (50.9%) overall retention under Mahalanobis + pooled correction at α=0.01.

twenty_newsgroups_reference.license_note: 20-Newsgroups (Lang 1995) is freely distributed for research use via scikit-learn's bundled fetcher; treated as 'by-permission' under the original author's research-use grant.

labels.source_description: Original 20newsgroups category labels for the 8-class manuscript subset: sci.space, rec.sport.hockey, comp.graphics, soc.religion.christian, talk.politics.guns, talk.politics.mideast, comp.sys.ibm.pc.hardware, comp.sys.mac.hardware.

twenty_newsgroups_reference.chunking: one row per newsgroup post; sklearn remove=('headers','footers','quotes') strip then truncate to 2000 chars; 100 docs per class sampled with seed=20260413
twenty_newsgroups_reference.citation_status: @inproceedings{lang1995newsweeder, title={NewsWeeder: Learning to Filter Netnews}, author={Lang, Ken}, booktitle={Proc. 12th Int. Conf. on Machine Learning}, year={1995}, pages={331-339}}
twenty_newsgroups_reference.manuscript_role: Third real-dataset replication in the manuscript cross-corpus validation. Paired with twenty_newsgroups_oos for class-held-out OOS projection-head evaluation: the reference snapshot trains the consensus reducer and projection head on these 8 classes, then twenty_newsgroups_oos projects 12 unseen classes.

twenty_newsgroups_oos.license_note: 20-Newsgroups (Lang 1995) is freely distributed for research use via scikit-learn's bundled fetcher; treated as 'by-permission' under the original author's research-use grant.

labels.source_description: Original 20newsgroups category labels for the 12 held-out classes, offset by LABEL_OFFSET=100 to be disjoint from the reference snapshot. Classes: alt.atheism, comp.os.ms-windows.misc, comp.windows.x, misc.forsale, rec.autos, rec.motorcycles, rec.sport.baseball, sci.crypt, sci.electronics, sci.med, talk.politics.misc, talk.religion.misc.

twenty_newsgroups_oos.chunking: one row per newsgroup post; sklearn remove=('headers','footers','quotes') strip then truncate to 2000 chars; 50 docs per class sampled with seed=20260413
twenty_newsgroups_oos.citation_status: @inproceedings{lang1995newsweeder, title={NewsWeeder: Learning to Filter Netnews}, author={Lang, Ken}, booktitle={Proc. 12th Int. Conf. on Machine Learning}, year={1995}, pages={331-339}}
twenty_newsgroups_oos.manuscript_role: Class-held-out OOS partner of twenty_newsgroups_reference. Every document belongs to a 20newsgroups category the reference snapshot has not seen, providing a true class-held-out test of REAP's projection head's ability to embed semantically unseen topical content.

corp_sustainability.note: Data extraction in progress. Loader at reap.datasets.load_corp_sustainability raises NotImplementedError until the snapshot is locked and entered here.
